faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtext: Everything you need to know about YoloHealth HealthATM.

items.question: What tests can the HealthATM perform?
items.answer: The HealthATM can conduct 60+ diagnostic tests including blood glucose, lipid profile, HbA1c, CBC, thyroid function, urine analysis, vital signs (BP, SpO2, heart rate, temperature), BMI, and much more — all without a lab technician.

items.question: How long does a complete health screening take?
items.answer: A full screening session typically takes 10-15 minutes. The AI generates an interpreted report instantly, and teleconsultation with a doctor can be completed within the same visit.

items.question: Is the HealthATM data secure?
items.answer: Yes, all patient data is encrypted end-to-end and stored securely in compliance with India's Digital Health Mission standards and HIPAA guidelines.

items.question: Can we integrate it with our existing hospital management system?
items.answer: Absolutely. YoloHealth offers API integration with major HIS/EMR systems including Practo, eVital, and custom integrations via our developer platform.

items.question: What is the setup and maintenance process?
items.answer: Setup takes less than 2 hours. Our team handles installation, training, and provides 24/7 remote support. Consumables are restocked as part of the service agreement.
